liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Deep Elem Blues**: rare: 6 archived performances [10]
- **Easy Answers**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 9 archived performances [10]

## The recordings

- **deadco2017-12-01.soundfield** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 180 min [1]
- **deadco2017-12-01.milab**: source not stated; 19 songs; 180 min [2]
- **DeadCo2017-12-01.travitz.schoepMK4v.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 176 min [3]
- **DC2017-12-01.DFW_akg483_akg461**: source not stated; 18 songs; 177 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer considers this the best-sounding recording of the show [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2017-12-01.soundfield**: taped by nakguy; source: Soundfield ST-450 (hyper-card 80*) > Sonosax SX-R4 (24/48) [1]. Also: Taper positioned about 15 feet high, using OTS, DFC and DINa placement; transferred via Audacity to 16/44 and FLAC [1]
- **deadco2017-12-01.milab**: taped by nakguy; source: Milab VM-44 Links (super-cards) > Sonosax SX-R4 (24/48) [2]. Also: Recorded with Milab VM-44 Links in super-cardioid mode into a Sonosax SX-R4 at 24-bit/48k; Taper positioned about 15 feet high, using OTS, DFC and DINa placement; transferred via Audacity to 16/44 and FLAC [2]
- **DeadCo2017-12-01.travitz.schoepMK4v.flac16**: taped by Jeff Travitz; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4V's>KCY>VMS5u>SD744t [3]. Also: Schoeps MK4V mics with Schoeps preamp stages fed a Sound Devices 744t, recorded front of board in the GA pit; Post-processing used Sound Forge Pro 11 for fades, CDWAV for tracking, Trader's Little Helper for FLAC, and Foobar2000 for tagging [3]
- **DC2017-12-01.DFW_akg483_akg461**: taped by CorFit Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG 483 (PAS) + AKG 461 (DINa) > Tascam DR-70 [4]
